(Hint: Get camo detection.)|Beginning of Wave 13 ([[Golden Mode|Golden]] & [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Ninja''' was an enemy that could not be attacked by towers without hidden detection. Without hidden detection, the '''Ninja''' was a nuisance. Compared to the [[Hidden]], the '''Ninja''' was slightly faster and also had more health. The '''Ninja''' appeared in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] and [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] modes. It was replaced by its counterpart, the [[Hidden]], in Beginners and Molten modes. Upon its death, the [[Mystery]] could have spawned the '''Ninja''' in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] and [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] modes. The [[Dark Necromancer]] could have also spawned the '''Ninja'''. Upon [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode's reappearance through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, it has been fully replaced by the [[Shadow]]. ==Appearance== The '''Ninja''' had black fabric legs, headband and torso. It had black skin and a drooling zombie face. It also had a swordpack on its back. ==Strategy== *Towers with hidden detection are the best way to attack '''Ninjas'''. **Most early game towers gain hidden detection. Such towers are recommended to deal with early-game '''Ninjas'''. **The Level 2 [[Minigunner]] is a strong option as the '''Ninja''' is quite strong and early game towers may not output enough damage to defeat it. ***Use of the [[Farm]] to get the [[Minigunner]] early is recommended. *For splash damage towers that cannot target the '''Ninja''', such as the [[Rocketeer]], if a '''Ninja''' is caught up in an explosion, they will be dealt splash damage. **This means that another detectable [[Enemies|enemy]] must be near the '''Ninja''' for a splash damage tower to hit the '''Ninja'''. *[[Units]] (like [[Military Base]] vehicles and [[Crook Boss]] [[Crook]]s and [[Mafia]]s) cannot target the '''Ninja''' but can damage the '''Ninja''' through collision. **The Level 2 [[Military Base]] is fairly viable against the '''Ninja'''. **However, do not rely on [[Crook]]s or [[Mafia]]s as they have very low health. *You can use the [[Frost Blaster]] to slow this down, though it is not necessary. **The [[Electroshocker]], while not having hidden detection, can hit the '''Ninja''' with a chain reaction if another detectable enemy is near it. **Although the [[Pyromancer]] does not have hidden detection, its flames can pierce through enemies, so the '''Ninja''' can be hit if there is another detectable enemy near it. **The [[Freezer]]'s ''Ice Age'' ability can slow the '''Ninja''' down. In addition, if a '''Ninja''' is caught in a [[Freezer]]'s splash radius, it will be frozen. ==Trivia== *The '''Ninja''' used the {{RLinkC|19398258|Swordpack}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The headband used by the '''Ninja''' is the {{RLinkC|11297708|Black Ninja Headband of the Silent Sun}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *This enemy was replaced by the [[Shadow]] in the Overhaul Update. ==Update History== *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Ninja''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Ninja''' removed, replaced with [[Shadow]]. {{Golden|[[Abnormal Boss]]|Wave 10|Ninja|Wave 13 (Formerly)|[[Mystery]]|Wave 16}} {{GoldenNuclear|[[Wasted Boss]]|Wave 10|Ninja|Wave 13 (Formerly)|[[Mystery]]|Wave 16}} {{LegacyFallen|[[Abnormal Boss]]|Wave 10|Ninja|Wave 13 (Formerly)|[[Mystery]]|Wave 16}} {{FallenNuclear|[[Wasted Boss]]|Wave 10|Ninja|Wave 13 (Formerly)|[[Mystery]]|Wave 16}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
